title: confidence.json: the Release Confidence Score (contract 1.12.0, not stable)
description: Since 1.9.0. Written by `harness confidence` beside the run it scores, and by `harness release` in out/<timestamp>-release-command/. The Gate first, then the RCS (only when the Gate is PASS or WARN) and its band, then eight dimensions, each with every point lost and its evidence. Advisory: never an input to the gate, a verdict or an exit code. Derived from Confidence in src/score/confidence.ts. Not stable: it may change in a minor release.

points.description: Points lost. 0 only for a finding that breaches the floor and costs no points of its own (since 1.10.0: a PR with no approving review, orphan changes in traceability).

why.description: What was read and why it cost points: names the hunk, claim, PR, file or run.

evidence.description: Where to look: a link relative to confidence.json into a run's report.html (…/report.html#hunk-<id>, #stale-claims, #noise, #masks, #load, #migration, #upgrade), an input file, or a PR.

floor.description: Present when this finding breaches the dimension's floor, which caps the RCS at 74.

weight.description: The nominal weight (src/score/weights.ts); the ones the mean used are in weightsUsed.

score.description: 0-100: 100 minus the deductions; null when not measured (never 100 for a missing input).

reason.description: Why it is not measured, and which input would measure it.

evidence.description: Where this dimension's evidence is: sections of the runs' report.html, or the input files.

gaps.description: Parts of what 100 means that this dimension could not check with what it was given.

key.description: What makes it the same finding in another release (a claim, a mask id, a scope, a file, a journey, a package).

hunk.description: The hunk (or section) in the run's report.html, relative to confidence.json (…/report.html#hunk-<id>, #masks).

claim.description: The claim that covers it, as the report labels it.

diff.description: The file in that PR's diff (changes.json's evidence).

hunks.description: Every hunk it stands for, when more than one (a broad claim's absorbed hunks).

detail.description: The evidence side by side: both distributions, the messages fixed, a mask's reason.

novelty.description: (n - seen + 1) / (n + 1) over the last six releases that recorded the kind; 1 with no history.

exposure.description: The share of the journey set it touches; 1 when it cannot be placed.

mark.description: The Reviewer's latest mark (glance-marks.jsonl), null until there is one.

gate.description: The Gate, as the gate decided it. Always first.

rcs.description: The Release Confidence Score: the weighted mean of the measured dimensions rounded down, capped at 74 when a floor is breached. null when the Gate is not PASS or WARN.

band.description: Green >= 90, Amber 75-89, Red < 75; null with no RCS.

meaning.description: The band's one-line meaning. Absent with no band.

note.description: Why there is no RCS, or why it was capped.

mean.description: The weighted mean before rounding and the cap, two decimals; null with no RCS.

weightsUsed.description: The weight each measured dimension had in the mean, renormalised to sum to 100. A dimension that is not measured is absent.

weightsVersion.description: Since 1.11.0. Which weights, floors, bands and deduction rules scored it: 12 hex of a SHA-256 over them (src/score/weights.ts, WEIGHTS_VERSION). A new value is a discontinuity the scoreboard shows. Absent in a confidence.json written before 1.11.0.

glance.description: Since 1.12.0: the reviewer's glance (C3), at most seven places to look, ranked by novelty x exposure (score, highest first), each with its links and the Reviewer's latest mark. Empty in a confidence.json written before 1.12.0, and when nothing was found.

glanceBasis.description: Since 1.12.0: how the glance was ranked, so the ranking can itself be reviewed. Absent before 1.12.0.

releases.description: The releases novelty read (the last six on the scoreboard, this tag's own runs left out), oldest first.

source.description: Where the journey set came from: the release run's capture.json, else the page groups of report.json's hunks.

notChecked.description: A kind whose input the harness does not have, and why: never made up.

seen.description: Every candidate's kind:key, ranked or not: what the scoreboard line keeps for the next release's novelty.
